purpose: bounded strategy selection and transfer on synthetic, same-author sources
development: 3 files / 12 entrypoints; select strategy here only
application: 3 different files / 12 entrypoints; no selection or retuning here
limits: 3 files / 12 entrypoints; deliberately unsupported forms; report separately
adoption_scope: document-output investigation on module-level direct-call Python fixtures; candidates require semantic review
unresolved_rule: unresolved call paths prevent automatic investigation closure; do not count uncertainty as route discovery
cost_note: candidate_count and edges_examined are workload proxies, not wall-clock, token, money or developer-effort measurements
truth: execute every decorated entrypoint under 3 fixed actor/tenant inputs with recording sinks; labels only these inputs
independence_note: same author constructed rules, source, input cases and oracle; no independent or blinded holdout claim
